dedupe_keys.name: ayuntamiento de barcelona cycling and walking datasets

description: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Inventario de los separadores de carriles bici de la red de infraestru; Carriles Bici de la ciudad de Barcelona; Carriles Bici en construcción en la ciudad de Barcelona; Carriles Bici de otros municipios del Área Metropolitana de Barcelona. Formats seen: ZIP, X-ZIPPED-SHP, CSV, JSON, PLAIN. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
